# ONXI Teamwear

> UK football teamwear and grip socks brand.

## Canonical pages
- https://www.onxigripsocks.co.uk/ — ONXI home and brand overview.
- https://www.onxigripsocks.co.uk/shop/ — Football kits, training tops and grip socks.
- https://www.onxigripsocks.co.uk/story/ — ONXI design and performance philosophy.
- https://www.onxigripsocks.co.uk/merseyvalley/ — Mersey Valley FC official club shop.

## Brand
ONXI creates considered football essentials built around movement, confidence and match day performance.

## Products
The current collection includes football kits, training tops and grip socks in black, white and volt colourways.
